info.title: cakeutils public API
info.description: Token-only HTTP API of the cakeutils Velocity plugin (v2/API.md). Every route except GET /v2/health needs 'Authorization: Bearer cu_<id>_<secret>'. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json. Times are epoch milliseconds.

get.summary: Liveness check. The only route without a token.

Servers (id, display_name, online player count, players waiting for it, mc_version, platform, standalone, game) and the total online. A standalone server's stats and playtime never count toward the network scope; game is "onesoul" for a One Soul server, else null.
Known players by name; filter by online state and name substring.

parameters.description: true = online now, false = everyone else; absent = all.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip.

get.summary: Live playtime in ms: total for the scope, per server and per mini-server. Private mini-servers are left out of by_mini; their time stays in total_ms and by_server.

get.summary: One entry per One Soul server: round, state (prep, idle, running, exhausted, grace, ended), the current soul, how many souls wait (a count; the order is secret), how many souls have played, how many players are signed up for the round sign-ups are for, the next spawn, and the end of grace or prep.

The live card: everything a landing page needs in one call. State, the current soul (turn, time alive, phase, online, realm, second-chance clock, headline run figures, waystone count), round counters, the previous soul and the last five timeline rows. Never a position of the living soul, never the queue order. Poll every 5 s at most. headline ids: blocks_mined, mobs_killed, distance (centimetres), biomes, dimensions, advancements; an entry with no source data is left out. realm: overworld, nether, end or other. server may be left out with one One Soul server (400 with several).

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: A One Soul server id (velocity.toml key). Absent: every One Soul server.
